title: Network Security Engineer
description:
HIRING \| Network Security Engineer

Location: Noida  
Work Mode: Work From Office  
Shift: **Night Shift**  
Salary: Up to ₹6 LPA

Experience: 2–4 Years  
Education: Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field  
We are looking for a skilled **Network Security Engineer** with hands\-on experience in network infrastructure, security, routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs and WAN technologies.  
Key Responsibilities:

* Implement and troubleshoot firewalls, routers, switches, load balancers and VPN solutions
* Configure and manage Cisco network infrastructure
* Manage Fortinet and Palo Alto firewalls
* Support WAN circuits, data connectivity and QoS configurations
* Troubleshoot network connectivity and communication issues
* Monitor network utilization, availability and diagnostic logs
* Coordinate with service providers for network issues and corrective actions
* Maintain network diagrams, documentation and hardware/software inventory
* Support network cabling and infrastructure deployments
* Implement network improvements and maintain secure IOS/software levels
* Respond to network escalations and resolve incidents within required timelines
* Required Skills:
* Cisco Routers \& Switches
* Fortinet \& Palo Alto Firewalls
* Routing \& Switching
* VPN, WAN \& QoS
* OSPF, EIGRP, RIP, BGP
* LAN/WAN \& Ethernet Technologies
* Cisco Infrastructure Configuration \& Management
* Cato Networks
* Network Troubleshooting
* VoIP \& Video Conferencing

Preferred: Interested candidates can share their updated CV at:**shivi.shrotriya@networsys.com**

* CCNA certification required
* CCNP / CCDA preferred
* Experience with Citrix Load Balancers
* Cisco Wireless knowledge
* 5 years of experience in network routing protocols is preferred

Pay: ₹300,000\.00 \- ₹600,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Oracle Service Support Lead
description:
**Company Description**
-----------------------

**About Sopra Steria**  

Sopra Steria, a major Tech player in Europe with 51,000 employees in nearly 30 countries, is recognised for its consulting, digital services and solutions. It helps its clients drive their digital transformation and obtain tangible and sustainable benefits. The Group provides end\-to\-end solutions to make large companies and organisations more competitive by combining in\-depth knowledge of a wide range of business sectors and innovative technologies with a collaborative approach. Sopra Steria places people at the heart of everything it does and is committed to putting digital to work for its clients in order to build a positive future for all. In 2025, the Group generated revenues of €5\.6 billion.  

**The world is how we shape it.**

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Job Title**

**IT Service Support Lead – Oracle EBS \& Oracle Fusion Finance Applications**

**Role Summary**


The IT Service Support Lead will be responsible for leading the day\-to\-day operational support of Oracle EBS and Oracle Fusion Finance applications, ensuring high\-quality service delivery in line with ITIL best practices. The role will oversee Incident, Service Request, Major Incident, and Escalation Management while ensuring compliance with agreed SLAs, KPIs, and audit requirements. The individual will also provide technical leadership, people management, stakeholder communication, and continuous service improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Service Operations**

* Support the operational support for Oracle EBS and Oracle Fusion Finance applications.
* Manage the end\-to\-end lifecycle of Incidents, Service Requests, Problems, and Major Incidents.
* Ensure timely resolution of production issues while meeting agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Coordinate with Functional, Technical, Infrastructure, Database, and Integration teams for issue resolution.
* Drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implement preventive actions for recurring issues.
* Participate in Change Management activities, including impact assessment and release support.

 **Major Incident \& Escalation Management**

* Act as the Major Incident Manager for critical business\-impacting incidents.
* Lead incident bridge calls and coordinate cross\-functional teams during service outages.
* Provide timely communication and executive updates to business stakeholders.
* Ensure post\-incident reviews and lessons learned are completed.

 **Service Performance \& Governance**

* Monitor and report on operational KPIs and SLA performance.
* Identify service improvement opportunities and drive continual service improvement initiatives.
* Manage ticket backlogs, aging incidents, and service request queues.
* Prepare weekly and monthly operational reports and management dashboards.

 **Audit \& Compliance**

* Support Internal, External, ISAE, SOX, and Information Security audits.
* Ensure operational processes comply with ITIL standards and organizational governance.
* Maintain process documentation, SOPs, knowledge articles, and audit evidence.
* Support risk assessments and compliance initiatives.

 **People Management**

* Lead and mentor a team of Service Support Analysts.
* Manage workload allocation, shift planning, performance reviews, coaching, and career development.
* Identify training needs and develop team capabilities in Oracle Fusion, Oracle EBS, and ITIL processes.
* Foster a customer\-focused and collaborative team culture.

 **Stakeholder Management**

* Build strong relationships with Business Users, Service Delivery Managers, Vendors, and Technical Teams.
* Conduct service review meetings and provide operational updates.
* Ensure customer satisfaction through proactive communication and service excellence.

 **Required Skills \& Experience**

**Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Oracle EBS and Oracle Fusion Finance Applications.
* Good understanding of Finance modules such as General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Fixed Assets (FA), Cash Management (CM), Procurement, and Purchasing.
* Experience with ServiceNow, TOPdesk, or similar ITSM tools.
* Good understanding of Oracle application support processes.
* Strong understanding of ITIL Service Management processes:

 **Leadership Competencies**

* Strong leadership and people management skills.
* Effective decision\-making under pressure.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced production support environment.

 **Experience**

* 8–12 years of IT Application Support experience.
* Minimum 3–5 years leading Oracle EBS and/or Oracle Fusion Application Support teams.
* Experience managing global support operations and production support environments.
* Proven experience in SLA/KPI management, audits, and service governance.

 **Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* MBA Finance, BCom \& M.com , MCA
* ITIL Foundation Certification (preferred).
* Oracle Fusion certifications are an added advantage.

  

This role is ideal for an experienced service support leader who can ensure operational excellence, maintain high service quality, lead teams effectively, and drive continuous improvement across Oracle EBS and Oracle Fusion Finance application support services within an ITIL framework.

  

Total Experience Expected: 08\-10 years

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* ITIL Foundation Certification (preferred).
* Oracle Fusion certifications are an added advantage.
**Additional Information**
--------------------------


UK Shift 12:30 to 9:30 in Summers


1:30 to 10:30 in winters

title: Security Analyst I, Threat Hunting (Pre-Sales Support)
description:
**About Bolster**
Bolster turns the security paradigm upside down and removes threats and digital risks before an attack occurs. Our protection extends beyond the enterprise to customers and partners. Our approach is the antithesis of today’s cyber defense strategy, which is to wait for an attack than try and prevent it. Or worse, assume you have been breached and hope you can detect it. We leverage the power of AI to apply deep learning, computer vision, and natural language processing to identify criminal intent on millions of web pages daily. We tirelessly monitor the Internet to find malicious web pages that could cause harm and remove them. We empower companies to take back control of the Internet by continuously eliminating the threats that threaten their business, customers, and brand.

We are just getting started, and the future could not be more exciting. We’re growing the team in all functions as we transition from a small start\-up into the next phase of our journey. We are looking for A\-list talent who will have a meaningful impact, solve new challenges, and take ownership of the future of Bolster. If this is you, apply and join our team! **JOB ROLE**

As a Threat Hunting Analyst (Pre Sales Support), you will play a critical role in supporting the Sales / Pre\-Sales team by demonstrating the strength of our threat detection and investigation capabilities to prospective customers. You will conduct targeted threat investigations, analyze phishing and scam infrastructure, and translate technical findings into impactful insights that support customer acquisition and trust\-building.
This role bridges Threat Hunting expertise with customer\-facing engagement, requiring strong technical depth along with excellent communication skills.
### **Responsibilities**

* Conduct investigative threat hunts for Bolster’s prospective customers across web, social media platforms, mobile applications etc.
* Identify phishing, scam, impersonation, malicious domains, credential harvesting sites, fake login portals, and related attacker infrastructure across multiple modules.
* Analyze phishing infrastructure including domains, hosting patterns, redirects, phishing kits, cloaking techniques, and attacker tooling.
* Prepare detailed pre\-sales investigation reports, executive summaries, and technical findings tailored to customer audiences.
* Partner closely with Sales team during demos and proof\-of\-concept (POC) engagements.
* Support RFP/RFI responses with technical inputs related to threat hunting, detection capabilities, and investigative workflows.
* Generate periodic and ad\-hoc reports highlighting threat activity and detection insights.
* Contribute to internal knowledge repositories and reusable investigation playbooks for pre\-sales use cases.
### **Required Skills / Qualifications**

* 1\+ years of hands\-on experience in threat hunting, with prior experience in supporting Pre\-Sales team, or customer demos in a cybersecurity environment.
* Strong understanding of threat hunting methodologies and the threat intelligence lifecycle.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced, SLA\-driven environment.
* Experience analyzing phishing emails, websites, SMS, ads, domain abuse, and social media impersonation.
* Familiarity with phishing kits, hosting analysis, domain infrastructure, and attacker tradecraft.
* Experience working with OSINT tools, enrichment platforms, and large datasets.
* Ability to translate technical findings into clear, customer\-friendly narratives.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience in startup or high\-growth environments is a plus.


**WORK TIMINGS \- 5 PM IST \- 2 AM IST****REMOTE WORKING**
**Why Bolster**  

Bolster builds a next\-generation AI\-powered fraud prevention and brand protection platform designed to detect and eliminate phishing, impersonation, and online scams at internet scale. Our platform protects enterprises from external digital threats across websites, social media, mobile apps, messaging platforms, and the dark web—helping organizations safeguard their brands and customers from rapidly evolving cyberattacks.  

Bolster is trusted by leading global enterprises and Fortune 500 companies that rely on our technology to detect and automatically take down phishing and impersonation attacks in real time.  

Our team brings deep cybersecurity expertise with decades of combined experience across leading technology and security organizations. Bolster is backed by leading investors including M12 (Microsoft’s venture fund), Thomvest Ventures, and Crosslink Capital, helping accelerate innovation in AI\-driven threat protection.  

Our AI and machine learning technology uses deep learning, computer vision, natural language processing, and large\-scale threat intelligence to detect malicious infrastructure and automate takedowns with high accuracy and speed.  

We also extend our technology to the broader community through CheckPhish (https://checkphish.ai) — a free phishing and scam detection tool used by millions of security researchers, organizations, and consumers worldwide. The platform helps identify fraudulent websites and contributes valuable threat intelligence to strengthen Bolster’s detection models.  

Learn more about our culture and values: https://bolster.ai/ **\*\*PLEASE NOTE THAT THIS ROLE REQUIRES IN OFFICE COLLABORATION/ATTENDANCE 3X A WEEK \*\*\*\***

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Messaging Services Analyst
description:
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Messaging Services Analyst to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN\-UP), India (IN).
  
  

Messaging Services analyst who manages and maintains the Microsoft 365 environment that includes various applications and services such as Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Exchange. Responsible for managing user accounts recipients, groups, service monitoring and reporting. Troubleshoot issues, provide technical support, and perform day to day support and administration tasks.
  
Job Description\-
  
* A customer\-centric approach with a focus on delivering high\-quality support.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to end users
* Understanding their requirements and creating a positive client experience throughout the total client journey.
* Flexible working in shifts supporting 24X7 or US business hours steady state operations.
* Individuals understand their own area and can perform all facets of their role. Good analytical, excellent communication and problem\-solving skills \- Energetic, self\-motivated and self\-sufficient in accomplishing tasks.
* Performs a variety of maintenance tasks associated with the support, modification, and updating and patching servers, also include software installations, upgrades and tests.
* Participates in troubleshooting and resolution of client problems using integrated data processing and communication solutions.
* Regularly exercises discretion and independent judgment on technical matters.
* Good working knowledge and demonstrated ability utilizing systems, tools and procedures to accomplish job.
* Build deeper understanding of processes, procedures, customers and organization


Technical Qualifications
  
Create mailboxes, assign licenses, and manage user mailboxes, aliases, and distribution groups.
  
Good knowledge of Microsoft 365 cloud services and applications, such as Exchange online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, and Teams.
  
Use of Microsoft administration tools, such as Microsoft 365 admin center, MS Teams and Exchange Online admin center.
  
Create and manage groups, distribution lists, shared mailboxes, and resources using Microsoft 365 admin center and Exchange Online.
  
Resolving and troubleshooting the O365 issues and incidents and escalating them to Microsoft support when needed.
  
Knowledge of ITSM tools/platform to handle service request tasks and Incident and management.
  
Steady state support to the email and collaboration services, work with end users and handling client issues and escalations.
  
  

Qualifications
  
3 years of experience in supporting Office 365 environments, with a focus on Exchange, Teams, and SharePoint platforms
  
Candidates must have excellent customer service, problem solving, and communication skills.
  
Microsoft Office 365 certification is a plus.
